offer.name: Product Photo Kernel Pilot
offer.target_delivery: 3-5 business days after receiving checkpoint access and buyer questionnaire
offer.capacity: one checkpoint, one product-photo objective, one validation cycle plus one prompt-pack retest

included: 24-prompt baseline pack: 16 train and 8 holdout prompts
ComfyUI baseline run and Calibrix kernel run
One portable kernel spec for the tested checkpoint
Acceptance review and one prompt-pack adjustment/retest if the quality gate is not met
One CBX1 ComfyUI/commercial license if the declared gates pass
not_included: FLUX or other base-model checkpoint license
Custom ComfyUI workflow engineering beyond the validation graph
Guarantee of conversion lift, sales lift, or production cost savings
New checkpoint, new vertical, or a custom reward model

follow_on.note: Follow-on prices are anchors for discussion, not proof of demand or a binding quote.

commercial_rule: Do not charge a customer for a verified outcome that was not produced and reviewed. A failed gate is reported as REVIEW, not relabeled as success.
